quote: Paul Smith's 'Periodic and nearly periodic transformations' published in Lectures in Topology (1941) is the foundational work associated with the Hilbert-Smith conjecture
note: The Hilbert-Smith conjecture is a generalization of Hilbert's fifth problem (posed in 1900). Smith's 1941 publication 'Periodic and nearly periodic transformations' in Lectures in Topology appears to be the earliest formulation of the specific conjecture that a locally compact group acting faithfully and continuously on a manifold must be a Lie group. No earlier explicit statement of the conjecture was found in Wikipedia articles or standard references.
